rules: All citation and evidence end offsets exceed start; Unicode code point count of quote equals end minus start.
Within a map, step, gateway, transition and condition canonical IDs are globally unique; observation IDs are unique.
Each step, gateway and transition support observation ID resolves to a map observation.
Each transition endpoint resolves to a step or gateway; any condition ID resolves to a condition.
A map requires a current model.
Current confirmation workflow ID equals map workflow ID when map is present.
Each finding and observation evidence source ID and revision matches a current snapshot source.
Current confirmation requires model and exact model version/content hash.
Current confirmation is allowed only in confirmed_for_scope or answer_ready.
Model is allowed only in draft_ready, confirmed_for_scope or answer_ready.
Answer is allowed only in answer_ready.
Each answer citation full SourceRef exactly equals one current snapshot source, including workspace and every hash/parser field.
Any page view width multiplied by height is at most 20000000 pixels.
